steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Match your public hostname to the S3 endpoint; set Garage's s3_region and root_domain to match your clients and bucket hosts. Turn off Automatic Let's Encrypt for a name that is not public, or clients are redirected to HTTPS.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point BunkerWeb at Garage's S3 API port, keep the client's Host and IP, and let S3 clients read Garage's own error replies.

steps.title: HTTP - Health check
steps.subtitle: Keep for uptime monitors (Garage's admin /health needs no token); empty only the host if nothing monitors it (the web UI refuses an empty URL), and keep port 3903 otherwise private.

steps.title: Methods, body sizes and request limits
steps.subtitle: Allow the S3 verbs, large uploads and bulk XML requests, and raise the default request and connection limits for batch clients.

steps.title: Bad behavior
steps.subtitle: Stop counting 404 as abuse: S3 clients probe objects that do not exist yet.

steps.title: Security - Review S3 request CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Five exclusions skip CRS policy checks on content type, a missing content type, two header names and object-key names, for signed S3 requests only.
